targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND s.avg_response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT
  response_time_ms as value
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.response_time_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
    AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) ranked
WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.95) + 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  response_time_ms as value
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.response_time_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
    AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) ranked
WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.99) + 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total_requests) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.window_start) * 5.0, 0), 1) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) AS time_sec,
  ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS p50,
  MAX(s.max_response_time_ms)                                                                   AS p99
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND s.avg_response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY s.window_start
ORDER BY s.window_start

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 500 THEN '< 500ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 1000 THEN '500-1000ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 2000 THEN '1000-2000ms'
    WHEN r.response_time_ms < 5000 THEN '2000-5000ms'
    ELSE '> 5000ms'
  END as bucket,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

SELECT
  p.name,
  p.location,
  p.version,
  ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS avg_response_time,
  SUM(s.total_requests)                                                                         AS request_count,
  ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2)                   AS success_rate
FROM proxies p
JOIN proxy_requests_5min_summary s ON p.device_id = s.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND s.avg_response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location, p.version
ORDER BY avg_response_time DESC
LIMIT 20
